name: postgres
description: Postgres MCP — read-only SQL queries against a Postgres database. Connection URL read from macOS keychain.
post_install_message:
Store the connection URL in macOS keychain BEFORE install (or re-install after):
  security add-generic-password -a "$USER" -s "POSTGRES_URL" -w "postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/dbname"
Installer reads it via:
  security find-generic-password -a "$USER" -s "POSTGRES_URL" -w
